facts.fact: UBOS states the National Population and Housing Census 2024 was enumerated door-to-door from 10 May to 26 May 2024 (reference night 9 May), counting 45,905,417 persons and 10,698,913 households; a post-enumeration survey put net coverage at 95.7%.

UBOS presents the final report (Volume I, Main) of the National Population and Housing Census 2024, dated December 2024; preliminary results came out on 27 June 2024 and provisional on 3 October 2024.

systems.owner: Uganda Bureau of Statistics (independent expert team)
